name: EnvVarDeclaration
description:
EnvVarDeclaration declares a value an agent or MCP server needs at run time.

 It describes what a blueprint needs, never the value itself: the value
 comes from a credential when the run starts.

fields.name: IsSecret
fields.description: Whether the value is a secret.

fields.name: Description
fields.description:
Human-readable description shown when someone is asked for the value.
 Should explain what the value is used for and where to obtain it.

fields.name: Optional
fields.description:
Whether the value may be absent.

 A run whose required value has no source is refused when it is
 created, naming the value and who must provide it.
